text: S568 applies the source-derived internal sew-line grading procedure supported by official CLO guidance. First inspect the running app's exact returned primary/modal windows; only proceed if the screenshot and accessibility state agree. If they do, make a fresh C:-only project copy, grade the four sew points using the source step deltas, export once and verify all five sizes. If they disagree, send no UI input. All V03 gates and holds remain unchanged.
